exportSummaries.DEFAULT_DEV_AUTH_IDENTITY: Additive single-user default so memory-sink / existing tests keep working.
exportSummaries.DEFAULT_DEV_AUTH_SECRET: Local-only default HMAC secret — never use for production claims.
exportSummaries.signAuthToken: Sign a compact HMAC-SHA256 JWT (hand-rolled via node:crypto; no paid/AGPL deps).
exportSummaries.verifyAuthToken: Verify compact HMAC-SHA256 JWT and extract identity claims.
